descriptor.name: GUGiK ULDK national parcel lookup (Usługa Lokalizacji Działek Katastralnych)
descriptor.scope: National point and exact-ID lookup of EGiB cadastral parcels (one parcel per request, WGS84 output requested from the provider). Live-verified on 2026-10-12 for 51 of 53 uncovered Polish UN cities (point containment, identical exact re-read, explicit absence). Earlier live samples: Warsaw and Kraków (2026-09-29), Bydgoszcz (2026-10-09). Bbox queries and area enumeration are unavailable.
caveats: Point and exact-ID lookup only: a clicked parcel never proves a viewport complete.
ULDK serves EGiB data held by county starosties; counties whose data is missing, stale or temporarily unavailable may answer with the same no-result line as a genuinely absent parcel.
Explicit absence is accepted only from the exact reply "-1 brak wyników"; every other "-1" message, count line, HTML or non-text reply is treated as unavailable.
Parcel IDs outside the documented TERYT form WWPPGG_R.OOOO[.AR_N].NR_DZ are rejected rather than coerced; unusual county numbering would surface as provider errors, not silent data.
Geometry is the provider's own EPSG:2180 to EPSG:4326 output, unrounded and unrepaired; the adapter rejects any returned polygon that does not contain the queried point.
Requests are paced to one start per second per adapter instance; GUGiK publishes no rate limit.
descriptor.operator: Główny Urząd Geodezji i Kartografii (GUGiK); EGiB data maintained by county starosties
descriptor.attribution: GUGiK ULDK · county EGiB cadastral parcels · parcel lookup on click
descriptor.licenceNote: Anonymous public HTTPS API without credentials. ULDK's own reuse terms were not read in this session (documentation host unreachable from the verification machine); confirm them before publication. Cadastral geometry does not establish legal title or survey accuracy.

jurisdiction.basis: ULDK is GUGiK's national parcel lookup that answers point and TERYT-ID queries from the county EGiB cadastral databases.
